name: pool, wash on demo_small_c1
source: Assay from md: tests/fixtures/demo_bead_wash.md (sha256 44feedfb34f7); grouped into unit operations by assay2chip S1-S4. Chip geometry, volumes and flows are ours, from demo_small_c1.
description: Runs on chip/demo_small_c1.json: pool, wash, in 3 steps and about 0.0 h. Generated by assay2chip S8 (s8_protocol) from the unit operations of 'demo_small'; nothing numeric about liquid is typed into the generator. VOLUMES are multiples of the volume_ul of the chamber each step runs in (pool_1 0.6667 uL, wash_2 1.3334 uL), and an exchange moves at most one chamber volume per wash. EXCHANGES declare what they are for: a sweep moves 4.61 chamber volumes, which is -ln(1 - exchange.target_fraction) at 99%, because a well-mixed chamber keeps exp(-V) of the old liquid after V chamber volumes; a fill is bounded above by the chamber volume; a partial states the fraction it replaces. FLOWS are derived per chamber from tau = 6*mu*Q/(w*h^2) on the real cross-section of the channel the liquid crosses - never a bounding box - at 85% of whichever ceiling is scoped to what that chamber holds, and every flow is also held under capsule.escape_pressure_kpa x control.pressure_margin over the whole route. Capsule handling has no wall-shear ceiling at all: pressure is its limit. DURATIONS are volume x washes / flow plus 25% for pump ramp, line dead volume and settling. REAGENT NAMES are generic placeholders from a closed vocabulary and are not a recipe; no concentration, vendor or enzyme name from the source reaches this file (CONFIDENTIALITY.md). RESTS ON CONTRACT ASSUMPTIONS (not published numbers): shear.prelysis_rinse_ceiling_dyn_cm2.

steps.note: Bring together into 'pool_1' what arrives from every chamber its channels lead from. One 0.666 uL chamber volume moves, driven from 'reagent_in' and vented at 'waste'. 48.3 uL/min is 85% of the flow that would reach 0.3 dyn/cm2 wall shear in 'wash_2' downstream (shear.prelysis_rinse_ceiling_dyn_cm2), using the chamber's y side (1.4907 mm), across a flow that crosses it along x and 1 mPa s at 20 C (fluid.viscosity_pa_s); wall shear here is 0.3600 dyn/cm2. Duration is volume x washes / flow plus 25% for pump ramp, line dead volume and settling.

Carry the contents of 'pool_1' on to 'wash_2' through whatever lies between them, driven from 'reagent_in' and vented at 'waste'. One 0.6667 uL chamber volume of carrier moves them. 34.2 uL/min is 85% of the flow that would reach 0.3 dyn/cm2 wall shear (shear.prelysis_rinse_ceiling_dyn_cm2), using the chamber's y side (1.4907 mm), across a flow that crosses it along x and 1 mPa s at 20 C (fluid.viscosity_pa_s); wall shear here is 0.2549 dyn/cm2. Duration is volume x washes / flow plus 25% for pump ramp, line dead volume and settling.

Sweep 'wash_2' with rinse_buffer through 'reagent_in'. 5 fills of one 1.333 uL chamber volume each, 5 chamber volumes in total: reaching 99% needs 4.61, since a well-mixed chamber keeps exp(-V) of the old liquid after V chamber volumes. 48.3 uL/min is 85% of the flow that would reach 0.3 dyn/cm2 wall shear (shear.prelysis_rinse_ceiling_dyn_cm2), using the chamber's y side (2.1082 mm), across a flow that crosses it along x and 1 mPa s at 20 C (fluid.viscosity_pa_s); wall shear here is 0.2546 dyn/cm2. Duration is volume x washes / flow plus 25% for pump ramp, line dead volume and settling.
